name: Transmute Fuel to Water
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, DF/M (a few drops of oil and water)

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./ 2 levels)

Effect up to 2 gallons of water/level

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance none

This spell is identical to transmute water to fuel but it changes an equal volume of alchemical fuel into plain, clear (and safe) water.
